# Alert rules for the checkout service.
rules:
  - name: checkout-latency-high
    expr: p99_latency_ms{service="checkout"} > 800
    severity: page
    notify: "checkout-oncall"
  - name: checkout-errors-high
    expr: error_rate{service="checkout"} > 0.02
    severity: ticket
    notify: "checkout-triage"
